headline: Northern Attrition Surges in Weathered Expanse as Island Clashes Shift
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, the eastern archipelago has seen fresh movement with frontline base captures reported in The Fingers, while combat in Godcrofts and Tempest Island continues to generate friction following recent garrison exchanges. On the mainland, Weathered Expanse has erupted into severe attritional fighting, logging a sharp surge of over two thousand combined casualties across the past two hours under accelerating fire. The contested grounds of Dead Lands remain locked in relentless bloodletting, sustaining heavy losses on both sides as fortified lines hold firm. Further east, Stlican Shelf endures heavy two-way pressure with steady troop deployments, while the fierce clashes in Marban Hollow have noticeably cooled from their earlier peaks. Across Farranac Coast and Fishermans Row, previous active engagements have settled into a tense lull, shifting immediate strategic interest toward the volatile island perimeter and the escalating northern front.
